title: Passage 54
voice: 温暖自然英式女老师｜IndexTTS2.5 慢速教学

sentences.en: How can we stop climate change?
sentences.cn: 我们如何阻止气候变化？

sentences.en: How can we live on a green planet?
sentences.cn: 我们怎样才能生活在一个绿色星球上？

sentences.en: Scientists agree that one way is to use clean energy.
sentences.cn: 科学家们一致认为，使用清洁能源就是一种方法。

sentences.en: Opposite to the use of fossil fuels, using clean energy does not produce harmful litter.
sentences.cn: 与使用化石燃料相反，使用清洁能源不会产生有害垃圾。

sentences.en: We just need to learn how to get and store more of it.
sentences.cn: 我们只需要学会如何获取和储存更多的清洁能源。

sentences.en: Plants can help us learn how to make clean energy, which could have a huge effect on our planet.
sentences.cn: 植物可以帮助我们学习如何生产清洁能源，这将对我们的地球产生巨大的影响。

sentences.en: The sun is a primary source of energy for plants.
sentences.cn: 太阳是植物主要的能量来源。

sentences.en: They use sunlight to turn water and air into sugar.
sentences.cn: 它们利用阳光将水和空气转化成糖分。

sentences.en: The sugar can be used as food.
sentences.cn: 这些糖可以用作食物。

sentences.en: The aim of some scientists is to get energy from the sun, like plants do.
sentences.cn: 一些科学家的目标是像植物那样从太阳中获取能量。

sentences.en: During the day and especially around noon, they can gather plenty of sunlight.
sentences.cn: 在白天，尤其是中午前后，他们可以收集到充足的阳光。

sentences.en: They want to make a machine that can use the sunlight to make fuel from water,
sentences.cn: 他们想制造一种能利用阳光从水中制造燃料的机器，

sentences.en: which will allow us to use clean energy.
sentences.cn: 这将使我们能够使用清洁能源。

sentences.en: Water is made up of two different parts.
sentences.cn: 水由两种不同的成分组成。

sentences.en: Breaking water into its parts is hard.
sentences.cn: 将水分解成这两种成分是困难的。

sentences.en: Plants do it all the time though.
sentences.cn: 然而植物可是一直在这样做。

sentences.en: With energy from the sun, the new machine will break water into its parts.
sentences.cn: 借助太阳的能量，这种新机器可以将水分解成其组成成分。

sentences.en: One of the parts will be used as fuel.
sentences.cn: 其中一种成分将被用作燃料。

sentences.en: Then the fuel is used to make electric power.
sentences.cn: 这种燃料会被用于生产电能。

sentences.en: The electricity can power cars, houses, our laptops, and so on.
sentences.cn: 这些电能可以为汽车、房子、我们的笔记本电脑等供电。

sentences.en: This fuel is better for the earth than gasoline or gas.
sentences.cn: 这种燃料比汽油或天然气对地球更有益。

sentences.en: Burning gasoline produces pollution.
sentences.cn: 燃烧汽油会产生污染。

sentences.en: Scientists warn that if we do not act, climate change could lead to disasters and put our planet at risk.
sentences.cn: 科学家警告说，如果我们不采取行动，气候变化可能会导致灾难，使我们的地球处于危险之中。

sentences.en: We need to balance traditional energy with clean energy.
sentences.cn: 我们需要平衡好传统能源和清洁能源的使用。

sentences.en: By using clean energy and lending support to its development,
sentences.cn: 通过使用清洁能源并支持它的发展，

sentences.en: we can protect our planet and ensure that future generations have the energy they need.
sentences.cn: 我们可以保护我们的星球，并确保子孙后代拥有他们所需的能源。
